column1: # XR33 transcription (unchanged values) of the 25 grade-A lenses of Brownstein, Bolton, Schlegel, Eisenstein et al. 2012, ApJ 744, 41
#   ("The BOSS Emission-Line Lens Survey (BELLS). I."), read from the arXiv source arXiv:1112.3683 (tables/t2, t3, t5), retrieved
#   2026-09-27.  No stellar masses are published there; XR33 derives them from the HST F814W magnitude with a calibration on
#   the SLACS lenses' own SPS masses (Auger et al. 2009) -- see XR33_lensing_imf.py, part S.
# Columns: name; zL; zS (BOSS); sigma_BOSS, e (km/s, BOSS pipeline, not aperture corrected; nan where not measured);
#   I814 = HST-ACS F814W de Vaucouleurs magnitude (AB, not extinction corrected); A_I = Galactic extinction; Reff = F814W de
#   Vaucouleurs intermediate-axis effective radius (arcsec); q; thetaE = SIE Einstein radius (arcsec); qSIE; class
#   (morphology-multiplicity-grade; E = early type, L = late type).
